newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Neutral Bunds eye upside target of 101.80.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Neutral Bunds eye upside target of 101.80.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE will remain neutral on Monday while they stay within a short term range between 101.80 and 101.27, technical analysts said.
Nico Bakker, inter-market technical analyst at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam, said a longer term range could be defined using the same top level but stretching to 100.40 on the downside.
"Upward potential is growing but we only advise increasing long postions with a break of 101.80," he said.
At 0708 GMT, September Bunds were down 0.07 at 101.50.
On continuation charts a high at 101.80 was formed on May 1.
Bakker said above that level, further resistance was offered at 102.75. That level was a continuation low on February 11.
To the downside, Bakker said support came in just below the bottom of the short-term range at 101.27.
"If that level is taken out, negative momentum will increase towards the 100.40 level with some intermediate support just below 101.00," Bakker said.
The high for June 6 came in at 101.00.
"But I don't think we will see that break," said Bakker. "I expect we will stay within the 101.80, 101.27 range."
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Markets in London, was positive for Bunds. He said the contract had closed above critical long-term support on Friday.

"This leaves the two and a half month sideways trading area looking like a bullish continuation pattern from which further strength can develop over the coming weeks towards the 102.50 region," he said in a research note.
The continuation high for May 15 was at 102.50.
Adcock said any short term pullbacks towards 101.20 should be used as a buying opportunity ahead of the expected move higher.
The market formed a low just above there at 101.22 on Friday.
At the short end, Septebmer Euromark futures were at 96.84, up 0.01 on the day.
